parsed.rationale: One of the two participating records lives at 'Shared/Wallpaper/Examples/WallpaperSampleApp/Sources/DebugHUD.swift' in the Wallpaper package, which sits under an Examples/SampleApp path — triggering the sample-app-mirror restraint. The other record is a production type-alias in 'Shared/DebugPanel/Sources/DebugPanel/DebugHUD.swift'. Lifting the production DebugPanel type into shared code to unify it with a sample-app copy would couple production semantics to demonstration code, which is precisely the anti-pattern the restraint rule guards against. Neither record carries fields or signatures that would independently motivate extraction.
